title: Home practical guide and safety card: rust jars and apple slices
subject: Science
unit: Spring 2: Changes of materials and animals including humans
source: Written for science/y5 lesson 22 (Home practical guide and safety card: rust jars and apple slices (portal worksheet; adult cuts the apple and boils the water))
intro: Lesson 22: Oxidation: rusting and browning. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To find out what makes iron rust and apples go brown
equipment: Tap water, boiled water (adult boils), oil
safety: Adult cuts the apple and boils the water
An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Jar 1: nail in tap water. Jar 2: nail in cooled boiled water with oil on top. Jar 3: nail in a dry jar
An adult cuts two apple slices; brush one with lemon juice
Leave everything for a week; label the jars
Check the nails each day and the apples each hour
Say what iron needs to rust

questions.q: Big question: why does a cut apple brown but not one in its skin?
questions.a: The cut surface reacts with oxygen; the skin keeps the oxygen out.
